title: Latvian politician, director Rihards Pīks dies
summary_full: On Monday, 7 September, Rihards Pīks, film director and former Latvian Minister for Culture as well as Minister of Foreign Affairs, passed away at the age of 84, his wife Sarmīte Pīka has announced.
